evidence.rule: Documented 5% four-band code for 47 ohm: yellow, violet, black, gold.

marking.appearance_status: Documented four-band value code; stripe spacing and shades are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Selected CCO MOF3WS is rated 3 W despite the legacy quarter-watt catalogue ID. The 15.5 × 5 mm KiCad body matches nominal dimensions; formed leads are 20.32 mm apart. The existing catalogue footprint and dimensions describe a much smaller part and need review. Blue coating is illustrative; CCO specifies gray or pink. Blue body shade is illustrative.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
